issues.title: Structural matcher can call a fact from the wrong source an exact match
issues.defect: Source is read but is not a hard filter or part of the structural match score; wave and country are only score bonuses. A fact from another survey/source can therefore match on relation axis/target/facet and be classified as exact.
issues.evidence: Constructed wrong-source/wave/country structural fact with matching semantic identifiers scored `exact_structural_match`.
issues.consequence: Evidence can be fused across empirical scopes, violating source/run identity and contaminating downstream packets.
issues.required: Apply immutable producer-run/source/wave/country-or-shard scope filters before semantic matching. Similarity/scoring may operate only inside an exact identity boundary.
tests: Wrong source can never match regardless of semantic score.
Wrong wave/country/shard cannot cross the declared packet scope unless an explicit governed cross-scope relation says so.
